task: Closed 10 code-review gaps in .xlsb ingestion/extraction parity: tightened the python-calamine version constraint, added MIME-only routing to the markitdown XlsxConverter, added filename-extension MIME fallback for ADO/XWiki attachment dispatch, added a typed UnreadableWorkbookError propagated through serial and multiprocessing datasource paths, and updated config, tool descriptions, and tests.

component_scope.label: XXL
component_scope.affected: XlsbLoader, FilesDatasourceLoader/file_extraction_utils (serial + multiprocessing paths), AzureDevOpsWikiLoader, AzureDevOpsWorkItemLoader, AttachmentContentMixin, XWiki ReadPageAttachmentContentTool, EmailAnalysisTool, XlsxTool, markitdown XlsxConverter, and the shared UnreadableWorkbookError exception contract
component_scope.layers: Workflow (datasource ingestion loaders, serial + multiprocessing) + Agent-Tool (ADO, xwiki, email, xlsx) + shared core exceptions

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Scope was a concrete 10-item checklist derived from named code-review findings (CR-001..CR-005 plus follow-ups); minor per-call-site judgment needed on MIME-vs-extension fallback precedence, otherwise well-specified.

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Custom UnreadableWorkbookError must survive pickling across the ProcessPoolExecutor boundary (multiprocessing datasource path) via an explicit __reduce__; MIME-vs-extension read-engine resolution logic is duplicated across 4+ independent call sites (ADO wiki loader, ADO work item loader, AttachmentContentMixin, XWiki attachment tool), risking inconsistency if one site diverges.
technical_risk.mitigation: Explicit __reduce__ implementation for clean cross-process reconstruction; consistent _resolve_excel_ext-style helper pattern reused per call site; rewritten/added tests across all touched loaders and tools; no security- or performance-critical path affected.

dependencies.label: S
version_changes: python-calamine constraint tightened in pyproject.toml (pre-existing dependency, no new package added)

key_reasoning.reason: Touches 10+ distinct components across the datasource ingestion pipeline (serial + multiprocessing paths), Azure DevOps wiki/work-item loaders, xwiki attachment tool, email tool, and xlsx tool/converter, plus the shared UnreadableWorkbookError exception contract used across process boundaries — breadth spans multiple independent subsystems.

27 files changed (26 modified + 1 new), exceeding the 16+ modified-file threshold; individual diffs are small (601 insertions/53 deletions, ~22 lines/file average) but the fix pattern was applied consistently across nearly every subsystem touched by the original xlsb feature.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from XL (5) to XXL (6): touches the shared UnreadableWorkbookError exception contract in src/codemie/datasource/exceptions.py, reused across the serial and multiprocessing (ProcessPoolExecutor) extraction paths.
Component Scope also matches 'affects multiple workflows or agents' (ADO wiki, ADO work item, xwiki, email, xlsx tool all touched) — already capped at XXL (6).
